title: The Trial
author: Franz Kafka
summary: A respectable bank clerk is arrested one morning and never told what he is accused of. He spends the rest of the book trying to navigate a court that no one can explain.
readIf: you like unsettling, airless stories about bureaucracy and guilt that you can read as a nightmare or a joke.
skipIf: you need a clear plot, a fair resolution or characters who learn from what happens to them.

pairings.reason: Kafka at his shortest and strangest, with the same dread of an absurd, unexplained fate landing on an ordinary man.
Takes the faceless-authority fear of The Trial and builds an entire state around it, with far more plot and politics.
Another short, cold novel about a man judged by a system that cares less about what he did than who he seems to be.
